import sys

class Point:
    def __init__(self, x1, x2, x3, x4, x5):
        self.x1 = x1
        self.x2 = x2
        self.x3 = x3
        self.x4 = x4
        self.x5 = x5

    def prod(self, other):
        return (self.x1 * other.x1 + self.x2 * other.x2 +
                self.x3 * other.x3 + self.x4 * other.x4 +
                self.x5 * other.x5)

    def sub(self, other):
        return Point(self.x1 - other.x1, self.x2 - other.x2,
                     self.x3 - other.x3, self.x4 - other.x4,
                     self.x5 - other.x5)

def check(points, i):
    ith = points[i]
    n = len(points)
    for j in range(n):
        if j == i:
            continue
        for k in range(n):
            if k == i or k == j:
                continue
            x = points[j].sub(ith)
            y = points[k].sub(ith)
            if x.prod(y) > 0:
                return False
    return True

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    if n > 11:
        sys.stdout.write("0\n")
        return

    points = []
    for _ in range(n):
        x1 = int(next(it))
        x2 = int(next(it))
        x3 = int(next(it))
        x4 = int(next(it))
        x5 = int(next(it))
        points.append(Point(x1, x2, x3, x4, x5))

    ret = [i + 1 for i in range(n) if check(points, i)]

    sys.stdout.write(str(len(ret)) + "\n")
    for idx in ret:
        sys.stdout.write(str(idx) + "\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
